statement: Let B = {(i,j) | 0 <= i < m, 0 <= j < n, grid[i][j] = 1}. For a set S of positions, define stable(S) as the union of all 4-connected components of S that contain at least one position in row 0 (i.e., with first coordinate 0). Let S_0 = stable(B). For k = 0,1,...,len(hits)-1, let h_k = (hits[k][0], hits[k][1]). Define T_k = S_k \ {h_k} if h_k ∈ S_k, else T_k = S_k. Define S_{k+1} = stable(T_k). The function returns a result r such that len(r) = len(hits) and for every k with 0 <= k < len(hits), r[k] = |T_k| - |S_{k+1}|.
preconditions: grid is a non-empty slice of non-empty vectors of 64-bit integers, all rows have the same length n, with m = len(grid) and 1 <= m, n <= 200. Every entry of grid is 0 or 1. hits is a non-empty slice of vectors of 64-bit integers, each of length 2, with 1 <= len(hits) <= 40000. For every k with 0 <= k < len(hits), hits[k] = [x_k, y_k] with 0 <= x_k < m and 0 <= y_k < n. All pairs (x_k, y_k) are distinct.
